Project Architect / Junior Project Manager
				
Curtis + Ginsberg Architects (C+GA) is an award-winning, social values-driven firm focused on affordable housing, community-service buildings, and innovative design for positive change. We design and rehabilitate affordable and supportive housing and community facilities that strengthen neighborhoods and improve daily life. Our projects turn complex challenges into lasting, tangible improvements in the places people live and gather. C+GA’s projects embrace decarbonization, reuse, adaptation and design to complement the urban fabric. We apply best practices in passive and active sustainability principles, resilience, and strategies that support community well-being into every space we create.
  
C+GA is seeking a Project Architect / Junior Project Manager with 6-9 years of experience in the design and rehabilitation of existing buildings, strong interest in community based and socially focused Architecture, the ability to manage complex residential rehabilitations, and take a lead role on large -scale multi-building comprehensive project. Experience with NYCHA or comparable public housing agencies is strongly preferred.
  
The immediate focus will be completing and coordinating construction documents and transitioning into construction administration. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of day-to-day coordination, maintain drawing quality, and resolve field issues in occupied residential buildings, working closely with the Project Manager and Partner. 
Responsibilities:
  
- Lead day-to-day architectural coordination and team production of Murphy Private through completion of construction documents and construction administration. 
  
- Coordinate with owners,      consultants, contractors, agency representatives, and other project      stakeholders. 
  
- Organize project scope, schedules, deliverables, and      agency submissions. Assign and track team tasks, follow up on open items,      communicate decisions, issues, and next steps clearly, and keep work      moving toward deadlines.
  
- Manage construction administration, including conducting      or overseeing site visits, field reports, RFIs, submittals, and change      order reviews.
  
- Coordinate design and production of all phases, existing      building evaluations, schematic design, design development, construction      documents, and agency approvals, including supervision of the project      team.
  
- Act as one of the primary contacts to construction      teams during construction administration services, including site visits      and coordination with the owner - private      and/or public agency.
 
Skills:
  
- Experience working on extensive rehabilitation      projects, from interiors to full exterior renovation / restoration, and      campus wide updates. Multi-family residential and affordable housing      experience preferred. NYCHA or other public housing agency experience      strongly preferred; affordable housing experience is a plus.
  
- Strong organizational, communication, and design      skills, with the ability to work independently, and with large consultant      teams. Able to set priorities, assign tasks, follow through, and keep      deadlines on track.
  
- Excellent project delivery experience, including      construction documentation and construction administration for complex      rehabilitation projects.
  
- Demonstrated ability to review consultant drawings,      resolve field conditions, and manage RFIs and submittals with day-to-day      oversight.
  
- Experience with NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission a      plus.
  
- Wide-ranging knowledge of architectural practice and      construction in general.
  
- Commitment to C+GA’s mission and to community-based,      socially focused architecture
  
- Experience with sustainable design. Passive House      experience and certification are a strong plus.
  
- Experience in New York City and familiarity with      Building Codes and existing building requirements required. Familiarity      with NYC Zoning Resolution agency requirements, accessibility standards,      and regulatory procedures is strongly preferred.
  
- Professional architectural degree from an accredited      institution.
  
- Proficiency in REVIT required. 
  
- 3D proficiency a plus.
  
- US Architectural registration preferred.
  
- LEED Certification a plus.
  
- Excellent written and verbal English language      communication and client interface skills.
  
- Legally eligible to work in the United States, without      need for employee sponsorship.
 Full benefits package provided, including health insurance and 401k plan. C+GA is an extremely collaborative environment with strong opportunities for career development and learning.
Hybrid Schedule after orientation period
Salary range for this position is $85,000-$115,000, subject to adjustment based on candidate’s experience, skills, and references feedback.
 
Interested candidates should submit resume, 3-5 work samples demonstrating relevant experience, writing samples e.g., minutes, field observations, and at least two references as one PDF to [email protected].  Limit submissions to 5MB file size. No calls please.
Curtis + Ginsberg Architects is an equal opportunity employer and will consider all applications without regards to race, sex, age, color, religion, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or any characteristic protected by law.
